notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Welcome, if you dare, to the first Tank Royale HALLOWEEN UPDATE! [/h1][/b]

For the next three weeks, we’re celebrating the scariest time of year with [b]spine-tingling Halloween specials[/b]! 
Enter the lobby if you dare and see what spooky surprises we have in store for you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34634528/e7373ae338d8554f96446e7ebe250caebff2c25a.jpg[/img]

This update bring special limited-time only Halloween features as well as some permanent upgrades! 
See the details below: 

[b]1.	Spooky Halloween Map! [/b]
Choose your tank and get ready for trick or treating on the scariest purple Halloween night you can see. Get ready for the new map full of surprises that will send shivers down your spine! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34634528/d8a3a22c976edf31d727dfcb0ba0b6419ca32a6c.png[/img]
[b]2.	Pumpkins, Pumpkins and Candy Everywhere! [/b]
Get ready to feel Halloween atmosphere the moment you enter Tank Royale lobby! Nothing like Halloween decorations here and there to bring up the mood. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34634528/ec8ad6066eec787a9f48f88df2e0d519ff0af313.png[/img]
[b]3.	Witch’s Black Cat is Here to Stay! [/b]
Panther tanks has been spooked with some witchy magic and now it’s overtaken by a crazy black cat! Check out the brand new skin in your garage. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34634528/4dcd9100735da8ec852aefc13ad038cd60582e06.png[/img]
[b]4.	Get Ready for a Daily Challenge! [/b]
What better way to stir up the competition than a little daily challenge? Play and win every day to get additional rewards! Every day you’ll get special gifts for the first three victories! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34634528/e032e409ea10188d3a3490d1c76e866bfe32576d.png[/img]
[b]5.	Bug Fixes! [/b]
Our team is working hard to ensure the best quality of the game and this time we got rid of a whole lot of nasty bugs: 
-	Radar will no longer be visible for tanks with Invisible effect on. 
-	We made sure the GUIDED+ item now always follows the target as it should.
-	The randomly appearing synchronization error has been fixed. 
The task continues! Bug reports are always welcome, so if you see any abnormalities in the game please let us know through steam community or at support_tank@bsscamp.com !

Happy trick or treating and wishing you all the things spooky! 
Enjoy this Halloween treat and let us know what you think! 

May the chicken be with you! 

Tank Royale Team

notes.title: BASE DEFENSE UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h1]Behold, the [b]BASE DEFENSE [/b]update is HERE! [/h1]

Our team proudly presents a whole new [b]PvE mode[/b] for those who want a break from Battle Royale struggles and enjoy some new challenge! 
In Base Defense mode you have to fight off the enemy tanks flooding in and protect your base at all cost! Every time you clear a wave you get to pick one of three random reward items. These are meant to help you survive the next attack, so choose wisely! 

Many items from the Battle Royale mode will appear, but we have also prepared some Base Defense exclusive items! 
[list]
[*] [b]TIME STOP [/b]– freeze the enemies and kill them all before your time stop runs out! 
[*] [b]SKY LASER [/b]– remember the red lasers shooting from the sky in death zone of battle royale field? That’s right, now you get to use it against enemy tanks! 
[*] [b]BASE WALL [/b]– at the start your base is surrounded by one layer of wall, so what better way to protect it than adding another layer? 
[*] [b]DUMMY TANK[/b] – faced with enemies who outnumber you a decoy might turn out to be quite helpful. The dummy tank cannot fight for you but it will attract the enemies giving you time to take action! 
[*] [b]AI TANK [/b]– now it’s just AI but still nice to have someone fight along by your side, right? [/list]

There’s more! 

If you enjoy the co-op aspect of multiplayer games invite a friend and face the tanks invasion together! [b]2P option available![/b] We decided to go full old-school when it comes to the PvE mode, so you can play together on the same PC (note that both keyboard and game-pad are required for two players to play together). 

And that’s not all! 
While we’re very excited about PvE it doesn’t mean we’re done with the main PvP battles! 
New [b]ENHANCED ITEMS[/b] enter the battle royale field! 
Look for items with a [b]+[/b] next to the name and see them blow your mind away (along with some unfriendly tanks and everything else on their way). 

Last but not least, we have also totally revamped the graphics style! 
We tried to modify the design so as to catch the game spirit better. We hope you like it! 

Share your thoughts, tell us what you think about the new contents and how we can make Tank Royale even better! Feedback is always welcome. You can reach us through the Steam community or by email at[b] support_tank@bsscamp.com[/b]. 


By the way, we’re celebrating this new update with [b]FREE GOLD EVENT! [/b]

Go to the E.T.C. menu, select the coupon icon and enter  [b]PVE500 [/b] ! 
Free gold will be automatically added to your account! Head to the garage and get that new tank design you’ve been saving up for! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34634528/c7356ffa83d1629abc61205ca60cab44ae124dbe.png[/img]
See you on the battlefield and may the chicken be with you! 

Tank Royale Team

notes.title: [Patch Note] 0.6.0 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Tank Royale loving users![/b]

We would like to announce a new update for Tank Royale is now available!
Download version  0.6.0 to enjoy the following new features and improvements!

[list]
[*][b]New Tank Joined the Battle![/b] New tank [MONSTER] has joined the battle field of Tank Royale. You can see it in the garage!
[*][b]Renewed Menu![/b] Preparing for the whole new PvE mode, main menu has been redesigned. Please be patient as we work on the first major update - Base Defense Mode!
[*][b]Optimization![/b] New font has been updated to increase the visibility. Network has been optimized as well.
[*][b]Annyeonghaseyo[/b] Now you can play Tank Royale in Korean. Select Korean in language options in game settings!
[*][b]Killing Bugs![/b] All reported bugs have been fixed. Please report any bugs you see so that we can fix them!
[*][b]500 GOLDS![/b] Enter [b][u]TOOHOT500[/u][/b] in the coupon to get free 500 golds!
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the new updated Tank Royale!

notes.title: [Patch Note] 0.5.4 Update
notes.notes:
Dear Tank Royale loving users!

I would like to announce update for Tank Royale, 0.5.4 is available in live server!

[list]
[*][b]Basic Armor Installed![/b] Now the battle will begin with 1 armor for every player.
[*][b]Supply Drop![/b] During the battle, items will be randomly spawned in some areas. Take a look around!
[*][b]Heat of The Moment[/b] If a tank is flown into the air following an attack, it will have a short time of invincibility. Get ready to face your enemy again!
[*][b]Whose Thing Is This?[/b] When you get the radar, you can see the EMP and Gravity Mines with their activation area.
[*][b]Stronger Mines![/b] EMP and Gravity Mine install times have been reduced!
[*][b]More Iron Walls![/b] Now you can carry up to three Iron Wall items.
[*][b]Real Super Power![/b] Super Power item has been renewed. Feel the power to clear the battle field!
[*][b]Who Is Talking?[/b] In the waiting lobby, you can now see speech bubbles above tanks of users who chat.
[*][b]Ni Hao…[/b] Chinese has been added. Check it in the game settings! If the text needs to be updated, please let us know!
[*][b]Killing Bugs![/b] The rare issue of no sound at the garage and other reported bugs have been fixed. Please report any bugs you see so we can fix them!

notes.title: [Patch Note] 0.5.3 Update
notes.notes:
Dear Tank Royale loving users!

I would like to announce update for Tank Royale, 0.5.3 is available in live server!

[list]
[*][b]New Tank Added![/b] A new tank has been added! Login and check out the garage!

[*][b]Stronger Mine![/b] EMP and Gravity mine installation time has been reduced!
[*][b]Practice Like Real![/b] Now you can carry the equipped item from the practice lobby to practice mode. Try different items in real battle environment!
[*][b]Killing Bugs![/b] Most of the reported bugs have been fixed. Please report any bugs you see so we can fix them!

notes.title: [Patch Note] 0.5.2 Update
notes.notes:
Dear Tank Royale loving users!

I would like to announce update for Tank Royale, 0.5.2 is available in live server!

[list]
[*][b]Super Power Power Up![/b] : When you get Super Power item, your tank will fire all three attacks simultaneously.
[*][b]Warning EMP![/b] : Now, when you step on EMP mine, shield, booster, gigantic, super armor buffs will be disabled.
[*][b]Iron Wall Everywhere![/b] : You can install Iron Wall everywhere, even on water!
[*][b]Check Slot[/b] : If you can not obtain an item due to full slot, warning UI will be displayed.
[*][b]Broad Invitation[/b] : Now, friend invite for a due mode can be received in garage, result screen and practice mode.
[*][b]Keep Calm And Farm[/b] : First death-field will appear later.
[*][b]Kind Chatting Bot[/b] : Chatting message will show the game status and chatting key for each game mode.
[*][b]Determined Chatting Bot[/b] : You will not able to spam chat with same message.
[*][b]Server Optimization[/b] : Server has been optimized for even faster matching.
[*][b]Killing Bugs![/b] : Most of reported bugs has been fixed. Please report any bugs you see so we can fix them!

[/list]

notes.title: [Patch Note] 0.5.1 Update
notes.notes:
Dear Tank Royale loving users!

I would like to announce update for Tank Royale, 0.5.1 is available in live server!

[list]
[*][b]Improved Control[/b] : Input method has been improved for a smoother control of a tank. (Especially game pad stick control has been improved a lot!)
[*][b]More keyboard control keys added[/b] : Now you can control your tank using [b]WASD[/b] keys and 123 keys from num pad. (Control key setting coming soon!)
[*][b]More game pads are supported[/b] : You can use game pads other than XBOX and PS. If you still have problem, check following :

1. Enter Steam setting
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34634528/99d94f17c8cdc230f5aee94558992eb1689cd490.png[/img]

2. Enter General Controller settings
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34634528/011de74ea1d4290c841dc445f91c7d8e6766ee97.png[/img]

3. Check Xbox Configuration Support
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34634528/c197cf802a1b10b0ad4aa861eb661728677c3717.png[/img]

[*][b]Faster matching[/b] : Now even faster matching is possible!
[*][b]Game tips added[/b] : When the tank is flying to the battle field, more tips will be shown!
[*][b]UI improved[/b] : User list sorting. During observation, tank information will be displayed.
[*][b]Killing Bugs![/b] : Most of reported bugs has been fixed. Please report any bugs you see so we can fix them! 
[/list]
